package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"
	redis "github.com/redis/go-redis/v9"
)

// scenario for redis_keys_command_in_handler: `rdb.Keys(ctx, pattern)` in handler or loop code
// fixture polarity: positive; family: library; severity: warning.
func scenario425Positive(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	rdb := redis.NewClient(&redis.Options{
		Addr: "localhost:6379",
	})
	defer rdb.Close()

	keys, err := rdb.Keys(r.Context(), "user:*").Result()
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	for _, key := range keys {
		w.Write([]byte(key + "\n"))
	}
}
